events.title: Cisco Jumps Most Since 2011 on Sales Outlook, Restructuring Plan
events.body: (Bloomberg) -- Cisco Systems Inc. jumped by the most in more than 14 years after the company delivered a better-than-anticipated sales forecast and announced plans to cut thousands of jobs, an attempt to focus on the fast-growing AI market.
